basis: Read-only comparison of the proposal, source registry, structured metrics, assumptions, audit pack and local protocol snapshots.
Every registered claim is tested for source, byte snapshot, metric interpretation, accountable role and stop-condition links.
No external field visit, participant interview, official geometry release or implementation authorization was inferred.
reviewer.limitation: This is a package-local review working paper, not an official review, professional sign-off or field verification.

included: The provisional geometry boundary and its derived metrics
The G0-G4 operating and audit gates
AI-off continuity, human handover, paid co-design and data minimisation safeguards
The optional SEB v0.5.0 and Switchback v0.3.0 crosswalk
excluded: Official parcel, road, heritage, fire, accessibility, utility or ownership conclusions
Field performance, service coverage, measured handover time or live protocol status
Implementation authorization, government endorsement, award selection or gallery publication

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 官方总体边界或重点区 polygon 尚未发布或无法核验。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: Official site or key-area polygons are not published or cannot be verified.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 保留 provisional 标记；暂停任何 official redline、精确面积或法定控制表述。
stop_conditions.action_en: Keep provisional labels and hold any official-redline, precise-area or statutory-control claim.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 正式 polygon 发布，或当前几何、来源或坐标基准发生变化。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: Official polygons are released, or the current geometry, source or coordinate basis changes.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 冻结旧的派生指标，重新计算边界、面积、比例、分期和空间映射。
stop_conditions.action_en: Freeze prior derived metrics and recalculate boundaries, areas, ratios, phasing and spatial mappings.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 临时几何指标被写成法定指标、官方面积、绩效结果或实施承诺。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: A provisional geometry metric is presented as a statutory metric, official area, performance result or implementation commitment.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 拒绝该主张，恢复 provisional 或 unknown 状态。
stop_conditions.action_en: Reject the claim and restore provisional or unknown status.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 七类 G1 核验域任一缺少证据、责任角色、阈值或通过结论。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: Any of the seven G1 domains lacks evidence, an accountable role, an accepted threshold or a pass decision.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 不安装、不开放；等待现场与专业核验。
stop_conditions.action_en: No installation and no opening; wait for site and professional verification.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 人工责任角色、申诉路径或撤场预案不可找到或不可执行。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: A staffed duty role, appeal route or removal plan cannot be found or executed.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 暂停活动，不把工作模板解释为运行授权。
stop_conditions.action_en: Pause the activity; do not treat the working template as operating authorization.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: AI 关闭后没有可找到的无扫码/纸质/现金等价路径或人工接管。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: When AI is off, no findable no-scan/paper/cash equivalent path or staffed takeover exists.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 暂停该服务路径，直到人工入口与交接记录可用。
stop_conditions.action_en: Pause the service path until staffed access and a handover record are available.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 报酬、工时、个人信息、录音或停用规则未在活动前书面确认。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: Compensation, work time, personal data, recording or pause terms are not agreed in writing before the activity.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 不招募、不记录、不宣称已完成共创。
stop_conditions.action_en: No recruitment, no recording and no claim that co-design has been completed.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 出现个人评分、情绪或身份推断、隐蔽追踪、生产性工单或未经批准的个人数据。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: Personal scoring, emotion or identity inference, covert tracking, production tickets or unapproved personal data appear.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 立即暂停并停止采集；不得将事件包装为服务绩效。
stop_conditions.action_en: Pause immediately and stop collection; do not recast the event as service performance.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 交叉映射被写成外部等级、正式采用、实时状态、实测性能、官方背书或部署授权。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: The crosswalk is presented as an external level, formal adoption, live status, measured performance, official endorsement or deployment authorization.
stop_conditions.action_en: Reject the claim and restore optional_crosswalk_concept_only.

claims.claim_zh: 官方总体边界与三处重点区正式 polygon 尚未在本包可用；当前几何只是临时粗略范围。
claims.claim_en: Official site and key-area polygons are not available in this package; current geometry is provisional rough extent.
claims.metric_interpretation_zh: 仅为临时几何的面积与数量复算，不是 official redline、精确面积或法定控制。
claims.metric_interpretation_en: Area and count are recalculated from provisional geometry only; they are not an official redline, precise area or statutory control.
claims.review_test: Before using a boundary-dependent claim, verify an official polygon and rerun every affected spatial metric.

claims.claim_zh: 七类 G1 核验域是待现场填证的治理清单，不是已完成的安全、消防、无障碍或责任证明。
claims.claim_en: The seven G1 domains are a governance checklist awaiting site evidence, not completed safety, fire, accessibility or duty proof.
claims.metric_interpretation_zh: 7 和 5 是清单结构计数，不是现场通过率、合规率或实施成熟度。
claims.metric_interpretation_en: Seven and five are checklist-structure counts, not field pass rates, compliance rates or implementation maturity.
claims.review_test: Require an evidence item, accountable role, accepted threshold and pass/hold decision for all seven domains before any opening claim.

claims.claim_zh: AI 关闭后的无扫码等价路径和人工接管可以作为待核验字段登记，但当前没有实测接管时延或服务覆盖结果。
claims.claim_en: AI-off no-scan equivalence and staffed takeover may be registered as fields for verification, but no measured takeover time or service coverage is claimed.
claims.metric_interpretation_zh: 5 类审计维度与 5 道本地门是工作包结构计数，不是协议等级或运行性能。
claims.metric_interpretation_en: Five audit dimensions and five local gates are working-pack structure counts, not protocol levels or operating performance.
claims.review_test: Demonstrate a findable human fallback and record a handover only after G1; otherwise hold the path.

claims.claim_zh: 五类共创角色是付费共创的设计基线，不代表已经招募、访谈或取得参与者同意。
claims.claim_en: The five co-design roles are a paid co-design baseline, not evidence that participants were recruited, interviewed or consented.
claims.metric_interpretation_zh: 5 是拟定角色类型计数，不是参与人数、参与率或已完成共创次数。
claims.metric_interpretation_en: Five is a proposed role-type count, not participant count, participation rate or completed co-design sessions.
claims.review_test: Check written compensation, work-time, data, recording and pause terms before recruitment or recording.

claims.claim_zh: 去标识服务记录和人工申诉是拟定治理字段；本包没有真实个人数据、绩效评分或生产工单证据。
claims.claim_en: De-identified service records and staffed appeal are proposed governance fields; this package contains no real personal data, performance scoring or production-ticket evidence.
claims.metric_interpretation_zh: 7 个记录类别与 5 类审计维度描述治理模板，不构成真实采集、隐私合规或服务绩效结果。
claims.metric_interpretation_en: Seven record categories and five audit dimensions describe a governance template, not actual collection, privacy compliance or service-performance results.
claims.review_test: Reject any collection or publication that introduces personal tracking, scoring, inference or production data outside an approved governance protocol.

claims.claim_zh: 面积、绿地率和公共空间率均是临时边界内的方案复算值，正式边界发布后必须整体重算。
claims.claim_en: Area, green ratio and public-space ratio are design recalculations inside a provisional boundary and must be recomputed after official geometry is released.
claims.metric_interpretation_zh: 指标有公式和当前值，但置信度受临时边界限制；不得用作法定绿地率、公共空间指标或绩效承诺。
claims.metric_interpretation_en: The metrics have formulas and current values, but confidence is limited by provisional geometry; they are not statutory ratios or performance commitments.
claims.review_test: Recalculate every dependent area and ratio from the same official geometry release before changing any metric status.

claims.claim_zh: 三处重点区运行与审计包是可独立阅读的概念工作模板，不证明已有点位、班表、责任主体或开放授权。
claims.claim_en: The three-area operating and audit pack is independently readable as a conceptual working template; it does not prove confirmed sites, rosters, duty owners or opening authorization.
claims.metric_interpretation_zh: 3、5、7 是包内区域、门和停用条件的结构计数，不是运行数量、通过率或开放天数。
claims.metric_interpretation_en: Three, five and seven are package-structure counts for areas, gates and stop conditions, not operating quantities, pass rates or opening days.
claims.review_test: Treat every area as concept_only until official geometry, site evidence, accountable duty and G1 decision are available.

claims.claim_zh: SEB v0.5.0 与 Switchback v0.3.0 只提供版本固定的字段语义对照；本包不声称外部等级、正式采用或现场状态。
claims.claim_en: SEB v0.5.0 and Switchback v0.3.0 provide version-pinned field semantics only; this package claims no external level, formal adoption or live site status.
claims.metric_interpretation_zh: 本地门数量只说明交叉映射挂接到 G0-G4 的位置，不等于外部开放等级或实测性能。
claims.metric_interpretation_en: The local gate count shows where the crosswalk attaches to G0-G4; it is not an external open level or measured performance.
claims.review_test: Keep the local adoption status unchanged and reject any sentence that turns field semantics into an external level, endorsement or authorization.
